description: This PHP source file defines a class 'Smarty_Internal_Compile_Private_Special_Variable' that compiles code for special Smarty template variables such as 'foreach', 'section', 'capture', 'now', 'cookies', 'get', 'post', 'env', 'server', 'session', 'request', 'template', 'template_object', 'current_dir', 'version', 'const', 'config', 'ldelim', and 'rdelim'. It is part of Smarty's internal compiler plugin system, enabling the dynamic compilation of these template variables during template rendering.

classes.name: Smarty_Internal_Compile_Private_Special_Variable
classes.description: Class responsible for compiling special Smarty variables into PHP code during template compilation.

methods.name: compile
methods.description: Compiles code for the special $smarty variables based on provided arguments, the compiler object, and parameter string. Handles different special variables by generating corresponding PHP code or triggering errors if the variables are not permitted under security policies.
